title: Length Run
core_verb: Steer the snake through the arena to collect growth orbs while avoiding AI snakes.
fantasy: An abstract enclosed arena where one growing snake competes against three AI-controlled snakes for energy orbs.
fail_state: The player snake's head collides with a boundary wall or any segment of an AI snake, setting health from 1 to zero, or the round timer reaches zero before the player reaches 30 segments.
win_state: Grow from 10 to 29 segments by collecting 19 food orbs, then collect the spawned target orb to reach 30 segments before the timer expires.

interaction_tags.meaning: Moving enemy snake; contact between the player's head and any of its segments reduces player health to zero.
Collectible orb that adds one segment to the player snake; 19 are available.
Goal orb that spawns after all 19 food orbs are collected; collecting it adds the 30th segment and wins the round.

notes: Slither.io's endless multiplayer arena is reduced to one player snake against three AI snakes in a single timed round: collect 19 food orbs and one final target orb to grow from 10 to 30 segments while avoiding lethal head-to-enemy collisions.

scene.description: A dark abstract enclosed arena with a glowing grid floor and boundary walls that emit a faint blue hum. Food orbs pulse softly in a spawn zone, rival snakes enter from their own spawns trailing coloured segments, and the boundary walls kill on contact. Glowing grid lines and energy pulses are the only decoration: moderate, and mostly open surface.
